instructions: Run each scenario independently with the current SKILL.md. Give the evaluator only the skill and scenario, hiding expectations and previous results. This is an offline simulation: no live service calls or git mutations. Assess the concrete next actions and authored PR body against expectations; do not grade exact prose. Report observations and unavailable evidence truthfully. Compare against the previous skill when changing behavior.
